questions.question: Which of the following numbers is NOT divisible by 8?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following numbers is NOT divisible by 8?
questions.solution:
T he correct answer is: a

Divisibility of 8: A number is divisible by 8 if the last three digits of the number form a number that is divisible by 8.

7497

Last three digits: 497

497 ÷ 8 = 62.125 (not an integer, so not divisible by 8)

7344

Last three digits: 344

344 ÷ 8 = 43 (an integer, so divisible by 8)

4608

Last three digits: 608

608 ÷ 8 = 76 (an integer, so divisible by 8)

5544

Last three digits: 544

544 ÷ 8 = 68 (an integer, so divisible by 8)
